description: Retained Pulp subsystems that no extracted view, design or render unit may link, include or carry. Each name is a core/<name> directory, a pulp/<name>/ include area and a pulp-<name> / pulp::<name> target (underscores and hyphens interchangeable). include_dirs names extra include directories whose headers belong to a subsystem but install under another subsystem's prefix. Read through tools/scripts/vellum_policy.py by vellum_closure.py, include_boundary.py, design_unit_boundary_check.py, vellum_mirror_edge_table.py and the view-core link boundary (test/cmake/test_view_core_audio_free.cmake).
